status: arithmetic experiment, not implemented handoff or hub gameplay

contract.coverage: own tile plus adjacent tiles; edge is eligible only when both endpoints are covered; crossing edge goes to another covering hub or regular carrier
contract.equipment: ceil(covered shipment-hop workload / 10) installed heavy vehicles per hub; no sharing vehicles between hubs
contract.shipment: one canonical good/origin/destination batch per adjacent-tile hop; no per-unit charging; split calls must not inflate or reduce workloads
contract.payload: All benchmark batches are below 100 units. A proposed 100-unit payload cap would leave these fleet counts unchanged; large-batch handling remains a design requirement.
contract.handoff: player retains goods ownership; no new market trade, extra port fee or artificial wait; provider assignment cannot reset progress
contract.carrier: existing direct transport tariff, not building-only middleman service
contract.running: original full diesel recipe per active hub per turn; five-turn frequency and 100/125/160 LC recipe output are explicit separate sensitivities
contract.partial_leg_billing: Prorate existing leg charge by physical edges. Whole-leg-only savings also reported because the current game bills per leg, not per edge.
contract.limitations: No live routing, occupancy/returns, loading, capacity failure, hub building capex or overhead simulated. Hub supply bought from middleman. Full corridor placement is geometric, not buildability-validated.

rounding_followup.rule: once per hub per turn, round each scaled recipe input half-up, minimum one for positive use, zero while idle
